note: Every source below was opened and read on 20 Nov 2026. A source is cited only after being read; nothing is cited second-hand.

sources.name: PowerPyx
sources.note: Also read: powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-meditation-spot-locations/ for the 18 spots across 10 locations.
sources.role: Step-by-step methods for nearly every trophy, the 3-step roadmap, the meditation locations, and the only missable warning. Its separate meditation page covers all 18 spots.

sources.name: Push Square
sources.note: Published 18 Nov 2026. The only guide putting the platinum at 300+ hours.
sources.role: Counts and prices: 42 shooting-range challenges at 2 ranges, 14 drone locations, WAiNK split 31/35/23, 18 card sets, and all 8 garage prices totalling $160,000.

sources.name: KeenGamer
sources.note: Updated 19 Nov 2026. Its unconfirmed flags disagree with PowerPyx methods — shown in the disagreement panels.
sources.role: Second roadmap voice: 200 hours, 60–80 hour story step, 42 drone time trials at 14 locations, and the honest unconfirmed flags on two trophies.

sources.name: Exophase
sources.note: List checked name by name against this guide; every name matches.
sources.role: The official trophy list as PlayStation publishes it: all 55 names, descriptions and grades, and how rare each one is among early players.

sources.name: PSNProfiles
sources.note: Counts cross-checked against PowerPyx and Push Square; all agree.
sources.role: The counts PlayStation tracks: 42 shooting-range challenges, 100 WAiNK scans, 100 vehicles, 250 stunts and the $250,000 / $100,000 money targets.

sources.name: GTABase
sources.note: Agrees with PowerPyx on one playthrough, no difficulty settings, no New Game+, no mission replay.
sources.role: Independent full list with grades and Gamerscore, plus a 3-step roadmap at about 200 hours and the 100% completion requirements.

sources.name: EGamers
sources.note: Information dated 18 Nov 2026; cross-checked against Beebom, CULTR, TechWiser, GTABase and PowerPyx.
sources.role: Independent cross-check of the whole list, with anything unconfirmed in two sources marked as such; confirms the hidden split of 27 visible and 28 hidden.

sources.name: GamesFuze
sources.note: Last reviewed 19 Nov 2026; cross-checked against PC Gamer, TechWiser, Beebom and Alcast HQ.
sources.role: Independent list with the same 55 names and grades, and a 5-step platinum route that agrees with the story-first order used here.

sources.name: Insider Gaming
sources.note: Warns, as this guide does, that hidden trophy names give away story details.
sources.role: Full list split into visible and hidden sections, confirming 28 hidden trophies and the spoiler split used by this guide.

sources.name: Radio Times
sources.note: Agrees on the 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze split.
sources.role: Plain full list of all 55 names and descriptions, used to double-check spelling and grades trophy by trophy.

sources.name: HowToVideoGame
sources.note: Its spoiler grouping is the model for this guide's spoiler cover.
sources.role: List grouped so story trophies stay out of the main table; confirms 12 story trophies (1 gold, 11 bronze) and 16 hidden side trophies.

sources.name: GTASpotter
sources.note: Confirms the PowerPyx method for Personal Best (max strength with both characters).
sources.role: Roadmap timing (200 hours, step 1 60–80 hours, step 2 about 100 hours), save-slot advice, and which characters each stranger quest belongs to.

sources.name: GameTrek
sources.note: Cited only where it disagrees, so the reader can see the other side.
sources.role: The dissenting voice: it maps the Chapter 1 finisher to Chapter 2 and counts 42 shooting-range challenges across 12 ranges. Both points are shown as disagreements, not settled.

sources.name: GTA-Zone
sources.note: Updated 18 Nov 2026; its list matches PowerPyx, GTABase, Insider Gaming and PC Gamer.
sources.role: Second voice for 42 shooting-range golds across 12 ranges, and for which stranger strands count toward the Strangers & Freaks silver.
